# Banner Maker

Banner maker: design a banner with your headline for a website, a store, an event or a sale, in a wide, square or tall format.

## What it does
Give the headline, a subline and the format. Claude tells you the price and designs the banner.

**How the files are made:** each banner is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install banner-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Banner Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/banner-maker/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each banner uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The banners show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_banner_models` | Models for banners with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_banner_cost` | Exact price of one banner before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_banner` | Starts one banner in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_banner` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a website banner that says Spring Sale 30% Off"
- "Design a banner for a tech conference on May 12"
- "Create a wide banner for my bakery with Fresh bread daily"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the banner (the headline, subline, theme and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
